scope: SWFI Key Enhancements Part 1 and the 2026-07-16 Smart Search feedback
checked_scope: The exact committed frontend was rebuilt with the deployed asset version and Git SHA.
The real public browser suite passed all 19 Part 1 checks without mocked network responses.
The broad public acceptance gate passed all 10 criteria, including the SWFI auth handoff without using credentials.
The runtime staleness gate matched the deployed release and asset version on both checked routes.
The visual gate passed all four checks across three viewports.
The 2026-07-16 feedback checks passed for search result relevance, AUM ordering, allocator recency, field-specific deal filters, and source-backed curiosity radar inputs.
The deployed backend passed 11 live health contracts and 40 schema-drift contracts.
Canonical source reconciliation passed with 168 active SWFs, 18 defunct SWFs, 186 total SWFs, matching total assets, and zero row differences.
The daily systemd freshness service passed under its production hardening rules and its timer is active.
The deploy receipt binds an immutable timestamped freshness receipt; a later audit advanced latest.json without changing the bound receipt hash.
The failed first freshness deployment restored the previous release automatically and left the public service healthy.
unchecked_scope: The complete external client query spreadsheet, presentation attachments, and final category-specific filter wishlist were not available in the checked source set.
No client-approved latency SLA was supplied, so observed performance is not labeled SLA-compliant.
The daily rail verifies source-backed routes and records drift; it does not mutate or refresh the canonical SWFI source.
The public forensic Node gate cannot read the production Mongo URI directly from its shell, although the independent backend reconciliation passed through the approved Keychain selector.
bad_news: The first freshness-aware deployment was blocked because the backend runtime user had no writable verifier home. Rollback succeeded; the image and runner were repaired and retested.
A mutable latest.json receipt pointer initially made deploy evidence unverifiable after the next audit. The final release uses an atomic symlink and binds the immutable timestamped target.
No source-refresh command or write authority was approved, so no refresh scheduler was invented.
remaining_risk: External acceptance can still expand when SWFI supplies the complete query corpus and category filter specification.
A source-side refresh SLA and an approved writer would be required before claiming that canonical source data is refreshed on a schedule.
The superseded 20260718T132622Z release directory remains unsuitable for source rebuild rollback; use recorded versioned image IDs and later real-directory releases.
